chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-'Attar (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Wahb ibn Wahb al-Qadi, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them).

He said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: Perform voluntary prayers in the time of heedlessness, even if they are only two quick rak'ahs, for they will bequeath the Abode of Nobility. It was said: O Messenger of God, what is the time of heedlessness? He said: Between Maghrib and Isha'.

key_terms.تَنَفَّلُوا: Perform voluntary (nafl) prayers — supererogatory worship beyond obligatory prayers
key_terms.دَارُ الْكَرَامَةِ: The Abode of Nobility — a name for Paradise, indicating divine honor bestowed upon its inhabitants
key_terms.سَاعَةُ الْغَفْلَةِ: The time of heedlessness — between Maghrib and Isha', when people tend to become distracted or idle

ai.seo_question: What is the 'time of heedlessness' (sa'at al-ghafla) and why is voluntary prayer recommended during it?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) encourages performing voluntary (nafl) prayers during what he terms 'the time of heedlessness' (sa'at al-ghafla) — the interval between the Maghrib (sunset) and Isha' (night) prayers. Even two brief rak'ahs during this time carry the promise of inheriting the Abode of Nobility, a Quranic epithet for Paradise. This teaching responds to the human tendency toward relaxation and distraction after the evening prayer, redirecting that interval toward devotion. The hadith is transmitted through Imam Sadiq and his forefathers back to the Prophet, using the authoritative 'ladder chain' (isnad musnad) that characterizes many al-Amali hadiths.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid from his father from Wahb b. Wahb al-Qadi from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as).

He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Perform a voluntary prayer in a time of heedlessness, even if it is only two quick units, for they will bequeath the Abode of Nobility (Paradise). It was said: O Messenger of Allah! What is a time of heedlessness? He said: Between Maghrib and `Isha’.
